summary: The diff updates the frontend to check availability of three static artifacts (build ZIP, SOURCE_CODE.md, and a new source-code.zip) and adds packaging scripts intended to generate these artifacts. However, evidence is insufficient (and in places contradictory) that the artifacts are actually staged into the frontend static public folder so they are served at runtime from `/artifacts/...` in production builds. Additionally, substantial backend feature changes appear unrelated to the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the files requested by the Dashboard exist as static assets at `/artifacts/app-build.zip` and `/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md` in production builds (served as real files, not HTML).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend now checks `/artifacts/...` paths, but the packaging script evidence shows outputs written to `frontend/artifacts/` and a root-level `SOURCE_CODE.md`, with no clear (non-truncated) step that copies them into the runtime-served static folder (commonly `frontend/public/artifacts/`) so they will be reachable at `/artifacts/...` in production.
evidence: frontend/scripts/README.md (claims staging into `frontend/public/artifacts/`, but not evidenced in script excerpt)

missing_requirements.requirement: Produce a downloadable source export ZIP containing the actual project source tree (backend sources and frontend sources/config needed to rebuild) and expose it as a static file under `/artifacts/` for download from the Dashboard.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI checks/downloads `/artifacts/source-code.zip`, and the packaging script starts creating a source ZIP, but the script content is truncated before confirming it (a) includes required rebuild config files and (b) is staged into the static public artifacts folder so it is actually served at `/artifacts/source-code.zip` in production.

The remainder of the script is truncated, so staging cannot be verified.
